PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere: MOM: See, {PLAYER}? Isn't it nice in here, too?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetC:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work of moving us in and cleaning up after. This is so convenient!
{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs. Go check it out, dear!
DAD bought you a new clock to mark our move here. Don't forget to set it!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedI:
MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?
Aren't you interested in seeing your very own room?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock:
MOM: {PLAYER}.
Go set the clock in your room, honey.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM! Maybe DAD will be on!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim:
MOM: Oh… It's over.
I think DAD was on, but we missed him. Too bad.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourself:
Oh, yes. One of DAD's friends lives in town.
PROF. BIRCH is his name.
He lives right next door, so you should go over and introduce yourself.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit:
MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}? You look a little tired.
I think you should rest a bit.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSo:
MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?
Then here's something from your MOM!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfToo:
Don't push yourself too hard, dear. You can always come home.
Go for it, honey!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav:
MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV? Someone from DEVON gave it to you?
Well, honey, how about registering your mom?
… … …
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburg: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this report from in front of PETALBURG GYM.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV:
There is a movie on TV.
Two men are dancing on a big piano keyboard.
Better get going!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual:
It's the instruction booklet for the RUNNING SHOES.
“Press the B Button to run while wearing your RUNNING SHOES.
“Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit the road running!”
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCam:
DAD: Hm?
Hey, it's {PLAYER}!
It's been a while since I saw you, but you look…stronger, somehow.
That's the impression I get. But your old man hasn't given up yet!
Oh, yes, I have something for you. This came to you from someone named MR. BRINEY.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLil:
DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?
If I recall, there are ferry ports in SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym:
I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.
MOM, thanks for looking after the house while I'm away.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger:
MOM: That DAD of yours…
He comes home for the first time in a while, but all he talks about is POKéMON.
He should relax and stay a little longer.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStor: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFl:
We bring you this emergency news flash!
In various HOENN locales, there have been reports of a BZZT…colored POKéMON in flight.
The identity of this POKéMON is currently unknown.
We now return you to the regular movie program.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay:
MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?
What color did the announcer say that POKéMON was?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon: MOM: Well, isn't that something! There are still unknown POKéMON.
